newsitem.title: USA: Envirotest sets shr tender for up to $20mln.
newsitem.headline: Envirotest sets shr tender for up to $20mln.

text.p: Envirotest Systems Corp said Wednesday it will buy up to $20 million of its class A common stock in a Dutch auction tender offer.
The provider of vehicle inspection services said it will invite shareholders to tender shares within a range of prices determined by its pricing committee under the Dutch tender offer.

Envirotest also said it will buy up to $50 million aggregate principal amount of its outstanding 9.125 percent senior notes due 2001 at a price of 100 percent, plus accrued and unpaid interest to and including the purchase date.

The company said the share and note offers are dependent on the consents of holders of its outstanding 9.125 percent Notes and 9.625 percent senior subordinated notes due 2003 to certain amendments to the notes' indentures.
One of the amendments would permit the company to buy back the shares in the equity offer. Solicitation for amendments expires August 18, the company said.
The company said the debt and equity offers will start as soon as practicable following the receipt of consents to the amendments. It added it expected to pay for the tender offers in cash.
